In a radioactive decay, neither the atomic number nor the mass number changes. Which of the following is

questionText: The reverse biasing in a p-n junction diode

options.explanation: Forward bias decreases barrier height (V₀ - V), whereas reverse bias increases it.

questionText: A point charge of 17.7 μC is located at the center of a cube of side 0.03 m. Find the electric flux through each face of the cube.
